name: DeepShop
description: DeepShop is a benchmark designed to evaluate web agents in complex and realistic online shopping environments. It features query diversity and complexity evolution across five popular shopping domains and provides fine-grained and holistic evaluation of agent performance on product attributes, search filters, and sorting preferences.
reputation: A recent benchmark for web-agent shopping tasks that is emerging in the agent-evaluation literature but is not yet widely established.
notes: Includes query diversity and complexity evolution; evaluates retrieval-augmented generation methods and web agents; highlights challenges with filters and sorting preferences.
